16:21.text: and Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the people of Israel, and all their transgressions, all their sins; and he shall put them upon the head of the goat, and send him away into the wilderness by the hand of a man who is in readiness.

16:22.text: The goat shall bear all their iniquities upon him to a solitary land; and he shall let the goat go in the wilderness.

16:27.text: And the bull for the sin offering and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall be carried forth outside the camp; their skin and their flesh and their dung shall be burned with fire.

6:5.text: or anything about which he has sworn falsely; he shall restore it in full, and shall add a fifth to it, and give it to him to whom it belongs, on the day of his guilt offering.

6:26.text: The priest who offers it for sin shall eat it; in a holy place it shall be eaten, in the court of the tent of meeting.

7:15.text: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.

7:11.text: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings which one may offer to the LORD.

7:12.text: If he offers it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the thank offering unleavened cakes mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil, and cakes of fine flour well mixed with oil.

19:2.text: Say to all the congregation of the people of Israel, You shall be holy; for I the LORD your God am holy.
19:2.notes: Not "Be holy, for I, the LORD your God, am holy" (Ch. 10 had a non-RSV wording). Ch. 10 bishop-readiness pass.
